open.title: Open Project
open.database: Select your project/GIS SQLite database file

close.title: Close Current Project?
close.question: This will close the project currently open, {name}. Are you sure?

fields.name: Project display name
fields.description: Briefly describe your project location (main river, country)
fields.descriptionHint: 25 character limit; spaces will be converted to underscores

import.title: Start SWAT+ Editor Project from QSWAT+
import.error: There was an error importing your GIS data.
import.introduction: This is the first time opening your QSWAT+ project in SWAT+ Editor. We need to import your GIS data into SWAT+ objects. This may take a few seconds to several minutes depending on the size of your project.

lteDescription: Use SWAT+ lte? This is a lite version of the model that greatly simplifies hydrology and plant growth and does not simulate nutrients, concentrating on gully formation and stream degradation.

scenario.title: Load Scenario
scenario.error: There was an error loading your scenario.
scenario.question: Are you sure you want to load the scenario, {name}? Loading the scenario will {replace} everything currently loaded in the editor (the default scenario), so please make sure any changes are saved as a new scenario if you wish to keep them. Scenarios can be saved from the {runScreen}.
scenario.warning: {warning} if you have QGIS open, you may need to completely close it first because it locks some of the files we need to replace. Make sure QGIS is not open, then open just SWAT+ Editor on its own before loading the scenario. SWAT+ Editor can be launched in Windows by searching "SWAT+ Editor" in the search bar.

create.title: Create a New SWAT+ Editor Project
create.error: There was an error creating your project.
create.manual: However, it is not required to use GIS to start your project. Complete the form below to start a SWAT+ Editor project from scratch. A project database will be created for you and you will need to input your spatial connections manually. If you already have a project database, click cancel below and choose the open project button instead.
create.folderHint: This will be where we create your project SQLite database file
create.datasets: Select your SWAT+ datasets SQLite database file
create.datasetsHint: This will be copied to your project folder above
create.datasetsRequired: Please select a SQLite database file
create.recommendation: It is strongly recommended to start your new SWAT+ project from within the QSWAT+ interface. QSWAT+ will set up your watershed and direct you to the editor after HRU delineation. For help using QSWAT+, please {website}.

reimport.title: Has your watershed changed?
reimport.error: There was an error re-importing your project GIS data.
reimport.question: Did you run steps 1 or 2 of QSWAT+ since last opening SWAT+ Editor? If so, we'll need to re-import your watershed data.
reimport.explicitQuestion: Did you run steps 1 or 2 of QSWAT+ since last opening SWAT+ Editor, or would you like to start over or switch between full SWAT+ and SWAT+ lte? If so, we'll need to re-import your watershed data. Warning: you may lose any changes you've made in the editor so far.

update.title: Updating Project
update.error: There was an error updating your project.
update.required: You must update your project to continue using it in this version of SWAT+ Editor. If you do not wish to update your project, please uninstall this version of the editor and {installEarlier}.
update.backup: Your project database may be modified during the upgrade. We will make a backup of the database and store it in the Backups folder within your project directory. There may be changes to the model inputs, so we recommend you {releaseNotes} to see what has changed {before} upgrading your project.

missing.title: Project Not Found
missing.description: The project's files cannot be found. Please use the open project button to select the project database file.

errors.load: Unable to get project information from database.
errors.name: Please enter a name for your project.
errors.datasets: Please select a datasets SQLite file.
errors.importName: Please give your project a name in the text box below.
errors.help: Check to make sure SWAT+ Editor is working properly by checking the Help page and scrolling to the bottom. Contact the developer if needed. First, you might try reloading in case your computer is slow to open the APIs:

releaseIntroduction: {link} to learn more about this release.

version.earlier: Your project was made using an earlier version of SWAT+ Editor. Your project is version {projectVersion} and the editor is version {editorVersion}.
version.newer: Your project was made using a version of SWAT+ Editor that is greater than the current version. Your project is version {projectVersion} and the editor is version {editorVersion}. You may encounter errors if the model has changed. Proceed at your own risk.
